notes: iris-3b Turbo (speridlabs/iris-3b rev adc05b9, Apache-2.0; text encoder Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct rev ebb281e): text to a 768x768 image, exported with litert-torch 0.9.4 and stored with ai-edge-quantizer 0.9.0's full_fp16_recipe (the form H), published as litert-community/iris-3b-Turbo-LiteRT main 743fd20a (last modified 2026-10-21T19:14:17.000Z; anonymous Hub API read 2026-10-22 JST: the 22 LFS files under model/ carry the sha256 of model/SHA256SUMS, and the git blob ids of iris3b_config.json, iris_tokenizer.json and SHA256SUMS equal the staged files). A pipeline record: `artifact` is the pipeline config the engine opens; it names the 20 graphs in order and sets GPU, FP32, P1 and no program cache for each. The files of one image are the bytes of model/SHA256SUMS: the text-encoder graphs iris_te_c00..c11_f16w (one per hidden-state tap of Qwen3-VL-4B's decoder), the DiT graphs iris_dit_{adapter,dual0,dual1,dual2,single0,single1,single2,pixel}_f16w_dit, the bf16 embedding table, the host tensor pack and the tokenizer. P1 = each graph is loaded, run and closed in turn: 41 compiles per image (12 + 1 + 4 steps x 7). Each image is scored against the all-fp32 upstream PyTorch image of the same noise (score_image.py: PSNR and SSIM on (x+1)/2); the pre-registered bar is PSNR >= 35 dB and SSIM >= 0.98 on all three prompts (apple, punct_num, japanese). A pipeline check, so output_match stays null and the scores are metrics; latency_p50_ms stays null and the image walls are metrics (first_image_wall_ms is the published speed figure for this phone). Harness: the published zoo sample (build 4), one image per hold: each hold installed the files with install_to_device.sh (on-phone sha256 against SHA256SUMS), then made the image through the app's Generate path from the debug verify extra with the reference noise, from thermal status 0/0/0; the app's memory guard (200,000 kB of MemAvailable) never tripped, and lmkd closed other processes in every hold, never the app. The logcat capture of the first hold kept running into the later holds (the background-reader trap), so the delegate lines are cut to each run's START-DONE window and pid.
quantization: fp16 weights: the fully-connected weights are stored as fp16 with a DEQUANTIZE in front of each; activations are fp32 (the Hub card, 'How it runs'); the token-embedding table is bf16 on the host
